hazard: A stale branch reviewed with a tree-diff against origin/main shows other specs' merged work as deletions, and the reviewer misreads the branch as destroying it.

grader.pattern: (?s)(?=.*review the branch's own diff, `git diff <merge-base> HEAD`)(?=.*`git merge-base origin/main HEAD`)(?=.*use it only to confirm the merge result after the branch is updated)
